head: Samsung Expert RAW may get a redesign with One UI 9.5
dek: An early One UI 9.5 build of Samsung's Expert RAW camera app, obtained by SamMobile, shows a new layout, two custom shutter shortcuts, an aperture range to f/22 and bursts of up to 30 RAW shots; Samsung hasn't announced it, and it's expected with the Galaxy S27 in early 2027.
